technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with some bullish structure (supertrend, Ichimoku) are offset by bearish momentum crossovers, price below key EMAs, and lack of confirmed entry signals—recovery bounce possible but insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ROK shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 64 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral overall setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (311.68) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals; earnings in 64 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) combined with supertrend bullish signal and price at support (220.99) creates technical bounce setup in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), bearish momentum crossovers (EMA death cross, MACD bearish, stoch bearish), price below all key EMAs, zero fundamental support, and no triggered entry strategies make this a high-risk bounce attempt without conviction.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) and supertrend bullish offer technical bounce potential in fear-driven market; however, bearish momentum crossovers, price below all key EMAs, and zero fundamental support create insufficient confluence for conviction entry.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 311.68, strong dollar) combined with bearish EMA death cross and MACD bearish crossover suggest downtrend continuation rather than sustainable bounce.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on weak setup; technical bounce signals offset by bearish momentum, macro stress, and fundamental void
decision.portfolio_note: Already 42 positions in Industrials sector (21.6% of portfolio); adding ROK increases concentration risk without conviction support—skip to preserve capital in unfavourable macro environment.
